resources.string: Merged. Claude closes the task on its next run

To merge from the widget (optional): the Merge button on tasks waiting for review merges Claude's PR from this phone. Edit the token and, for each project repo:

1. Repository access: add the project repo (for example Taskboard-widget)
2. Permissions → Repository: Pull requests: Read and write, Contents: Read and write, and Checks: Read

This gives the phone write access to those repos' code: anyone with the token could push to them. Skip it if you only want to read the board and approve tasks.
